nodes.context: NAS in the garage. 4TB spinning disk, runs Harbor container registry and family photo archive. Runs hot in summer — monitor thermals.
Edge node running Jenkins agents and CI/CD pipelines. Handles batch workloads. Modest storage — build artifacts should be pushed to storage node.

stewardship.context: Set up and maintains the hardware. Knows the RAID configuration and network topology.
Uses for photo backups. Knows how to restart if the NAS light goes red.
Primary operator. Manages Jenkins configuration and pipeline definitions.
